description: This file contains shell script code that performs tests related to the 'git grep' functionality, particularly in binary files. It sets up test cases, runs various 'git grep' commands with different options, and compares expected and actual outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a provided description and commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or streams for equality.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script that can be used as a text conversion filter.
